title: Applicability of part.
partHeading: PART II. ORGANIZATION OF BANKS, SAVINGS BANKS, SAVINGS AND
bodyText:
PART II. ORGANIZATION OF BANKS, SAVINGS BANKS, SAVINGS AND

LOAN ASSOCIATIONS, TRUST COMPANIES AND DEPOSITORY

FINANCIAL SERVICES LOAN COMPANIES

The provisions of this part shall govern the organization of Hawaii financial institutions that are banks, savings banks, savings and loan associations, trust companies, and depository financial services loan companies.
